entries.label: Goals
entries.desc: Goals scored, penalties included. Own goals are not counted.

entries.label: Goals /90
entries.desc: Goals scored per 90 minutes played: goals divided by minutes, times 90. Higher is better.

entries.label: Non-penalty goals
entries.desc: Non-penalty goals: goals scored minus goals from the penalty spot.

entries.label: npG /90
entries.desc: Non-penalty goals per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: xG
entries.desc: Expected goals: the sum over a player's shots of the chance each one had of being scored, judged from where and how it was taken (Sofascore's model).

entries.label: xG /90
entries.desc: Expected goals per 90 minutes played: how many goals a player's shots are worth every full match. Higher is better.

entries.label: Non-penalty xG
entries.desc: Non-penalty expected goals: xG with 0.79 subtracted for every penalty taken, since a penalty is a chance the player did not create.

entries.label: npxG /90
entries.desc: Non-penalty expected goals per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: xGOT
entries.desc: Expected goals on target: the value of a player's shots on target after accounting for where in the goal they went. A well-placed shot is worth more than its xG; an off-target shot is worth zero.

entries.label: xGOT /90
entries.desc: Expected goals on target per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Goals − xG
entries.desc: Goals minus expected goals: how many more (or fewer) goals a player has scored than their chances were worth. Positive means finishing above expectation; it tends to fade over a season.

entries.label: Shots
entries.desc: Shots attempted, on and off target, blocked shots included.

entries.label: Shots /90
entries.desc: Shots attempted per 90 minutes played. Higher means a bigger part of the attack.

entries.label: Shots on target
entries.desc: Shots on target: shots that would have gone in without a save (blocked shots do not count).

entries.label: SoT /90
entries.desc: Shots on target per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Shots on target %
entries.desc: Shots on target as a percentage of all shots attempted (denominator: shots). Higher is better.

entries.label: xG per shot
entries.desc: Expected goals divided by shots: the average quality of the chances a player takes. Higher means closer, better chances.

entries.label: Big chances missed
entries.desc: Big chances (situations where a goal is expected) that the player failed to score. Lower is better.

entries.label: Penalty goals
entries.desc: Goals scored from the penalty spot, counted from the match incidents.

entries.label: Assists
entries.desc: Passes that directly led to a goal.

entries.label: Assists /90
entries.desc: Assists per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: xA
entries.desc: Expected assists: the sum over a player's passes of the chance the shot each one set up had of being scored. It credits the pass regardless of whether the shooter finished.

entries.label: xA /90
entries.desc: Expected assists per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Key passes
entries.desc: Passes that led directly to a shot by a team-mate.

entries.label: Key passes /90
entries.desc: Key passes per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Big chances created
entries.desc: Big chances created: passes that put a team-mate in a situation where a goal is expected.

entries.label: Big chances /90
entries.desc: Big chances created per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Passes
entries.desc: Passes attempted, successful or not.

entries.label: Passes /90
entries.desc: Passes attempted per 90 minutes played: how involved a player is in moving the ball.

entries.label: Pass completion
entries.desc: Pass completion: successful passes as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted). Higher is better, but long passers run lower.

entries.label: Opp.-half passes /90
entries.desc: Successful passes in the opposition half per 90 minutes played. Higher means more of the player's passing happens in dangerous areas.

entries.label: Long balls /90
entries.desc: Successful long balls per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Long-ball accuracy
entries.desc: Long-ball accuracy: successful long balls as a percentage of long balls attempted (denominator: long balls attempted). Higher is better.

entries.label: Crosses /90
entries.desc: Successful crosses per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Cross accuracy
entries.desc: Cross accuracy: crosses that found a team-mate as a percentage of crosses attempted (denominator: crosses attempted). Higher is better.

entries.label: Touches
entries.desc: Touches of the ball.

entries.label: Touches /90
entries.desc: Touches per 90 minutes played: how much of the game goes through the player.

entries.label: Dribbles completed
entries.desc: Dribbles completed: take-ons where the player beat the defender.

entries.label: Dribbles /90
entries.desc: Dribbles completed per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Dribble success
entries.desc: Dribble success: completed dribbles as a percentage of dribbles attempted (denominator: dribbles attempted). Higher is better.

entries.label: Carries /90
entries.desc: Ball carries per 90 minutes played: sequences of the player moving with the ball at their feet.

entries.label: Progressive carries /90
entries.desc: Progressive carries per 90 minutes played: carries that move the ball substantially towards the opponent's goal. Higher is better.

entries.label: Carry distance /90 (m)
entries.desc: Metres carried with the ball per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Dispossessed /90
entries.desc: Times tackled off the ball per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

entries.label: Possession lost /90
entries.desc: Times possession was lost per 90 minutes played, by a bad touch, a failed dribble, a misplaced pass or being tackled. Lower is better.

entries.label: Tackles
entries.desc: Tackles attempted, won or lost.

entries.label: Tackles /90
entries.desc: Tackles attempted per 90 minutes played. Higher means more defensive engagement, which also depends on how often the team is without the ball.

entries.label: Tackle success
entries.desc: Tackle success: tackles won as a percentage of tackles attempted (denominator: tackles attempted). Higher is better.

entries.label: Interceptions
entries.desc: Interceptions: opposition passes cut out before they reached their target.

entries.label: Interceptions /90
entries.desc: Interceptions per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Clearances /90
entries.desc: Clearances per 90 minutes played: the ball kicked or headed clear of danger.

entries.label: Blocks /90
entries.desc: Shots blocked by an outfield player per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Recoveries
entries.desc: Ball recoveries: loose balls picked up to regain possession.

entries.label: Recoveries /90
entries.desc: Ball recoveries per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Errors leading to a shot
entries.desc: Errors that led directly to an opposition shot or goal. Lower is better.

entries.label: Duels won
entries.desc: Duels won: one-against-one contests for the ball, on the ground or in the air, that the player came out of with possession.

entries.label: Duels won /90
entries.desc: Duels won per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Duel success
entries.desc: Duel success: duels won as a percentage of duels contested (denominator: duels won plus duels lost). Higher is better.

entries.label: Aerials won /90
entries.desc: Aerial duels won per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Aerial success
entries.desc: Aerial success: aerial duels won as a percentage of aerial duels contested (denominator: aerials won plus aerials lost). Higher is better.

entries.label: Fouls /90
entries.desc: Fouls committed per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

entries.label: Fouled /90
entries.desc: Fouls suffered per 90 minutes played: how often the player draws a foul.

entries.label: Saves
entries.desc: Saves made by a goalkeeper.

entries.label: Saves /90
entries.desc: Saves per 90 minutes played. A high number says as much about the defence in front of the keeper as about the keeper.

entries.label: Save %
entries.desc: Save percentage: saves as a percentage of shots on target faced (denominator: saves plus goals conceded). Higher is better.

entries.label: Goals prevented
entries.desc: Goals prevented: the expected goals on target a keeper faced minus the goals actually conceded. Positive means the keeper has saved more than an average keeper would have from the same shots.

entries.label: Goals prevented /90
entries.desc: Goals prevented per 90 minutes played. Higher is better.

entries.label: Goals conceded
entries.desc: Goals conceded while the keeper was on the pitch, pro-rated by minutes when they did not play the whole match. Lower is better.

entries.label: Conceded /90
entries.desc: Goals conceded per 90 minutes played. Lower is better.

entries.label: Saves from inside the box
entries.desc: Saves from shots taken inside the penalty area, usually the hardest to make.

entries.label: Sweeper actions /90
entries.desc: Sweeper-keeper actions per 90 minutes played: times the keeper came off their line to deal with the ball outside the area.

entries.label: High claims /90
entries.desc: High balls (crosses and long passes) the keeper claimed cleanly per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Punches
entries.desc: Crosses and high balls the keeper punched clear.

entries.label: Distance (km)
entries.desc: Total distance covered in kilometres, over every match played.

entries.label: Distance /90 (km)
entries.desc: Distance covered in kilometres per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: High-speed running /90 (km)
entries.desc: Kilometres covered at high speed or sprinting per 90 minutes played: the intense part of a player's running.

entries.label: Sprints
entries.desc: Number of sprints over the season.

entries.label: Sprints /90
entries.desc: Sprints per 90 minutes played.

entries.label: Top speed (km/h)
entries.desc: The fastest speed recorded for the player in any match, in km/h.

entries.label: npxG + xA /90
entries.desc: Non-penalty expected goals plus expected assists per 90 minutes played: a player's total expected involvement in goals, with penalties left out. Higher is better.

entries.label: Goals + assists /90
entries.desc: Goals plus assists per 90 minutes played: the realised counterpart of npxG + xA. Higher is better.

entries.label: Finishing (npG − npxG per shot)
entries.desc: Finishing: non-penalty goals minus non-penalty xG, divided by non-penalty shots. Positive means the player scores more than their chances are worth, per shot so volume shooters are not favoured.

entries.label: Shot placement (xGOT − xG per shot)
entries.desc: Shot placement: expected goals on target minus expected goals, divided by shots. Positive means the player's shots are placed better than the average shot from the same spots.

entries.label: xA per key pass
entries.desc: Expected assists divided by key passes: the average quality of the chances a player creates, independent of how many they create.

entries.label: Shots + key passes /90
entries.desc: Shots plus key passes per 90 minutes played: everything a player does that ends in a shot, their own or a team-mate's.

entries.label: Progressive carries + dribbles /90
entries.desc: Progressive carries plus completed dribbles per 90 minutes played: how often a player moves the ball forward on their own.

entries.label: Defensive actions /90
entries.desc: Tackles, interceptions, blocks and clearances added together per 90 minutes played: raw defensive volume.

entries.label: PAdj tackles + interceptions /90
entries.desc: Possession-adjusted tackles plus interceptions per 90 minutes played: each match's tackles and interceptions are scaled by 50 divided by the opponent's possession, so a player on a team that rarely has the ball is not credited for simply having more to defend. Higher is better.

entries.label: Ball wins /90
entries.desc: Tackles won plus interceptions plus ball recoveries per 90 minutes played: how often a player wins the ball back. Higher is better.

entries.label: Duels contested /90
entries.desc: Duels contested per 90 minutes played, won or lost: the volume behind the duel success rate.

entries.label: Aerials contested /90
entries.desc: Aerial duels contested per 90 minutes played, won or lost: the volume behind the aerial success rate.

entries.label: Possession lost per 100 touches
entries.desc: Possession lost per 100 touches: how often a player gives the ball away, scaled by how often they have it. Lower is better.

entries.label: Rating
entries.desc: Sofascore's 1-10 match rating, averaged over the season with each match weighted by the minutes played in it. Around 7 is an ordinary performance; above 8 is a very good one.

entries.label: Yellow cards
entries.desc: Yellow cards, counted from the match incidents. Lower is better.

entries.label: Red cards
entries.desc: Red cards, counted from the match incidents. Lower is better.

entries.label: Minutes
entries.desc: Minutes played over the season, the basis for every per-90 rate.

entries.label: Appearances
entries.desc: Appearances: matches in which the player was on the pitch for at least a minute.

entries.label: Starts
entries.desc: Matches the player started.

entries.label: xG for
entries.desc: Expected goals created per match: the sum of the chance each shot had of being scored. Higher is better.

entries.label: xG against
entries.desc: Expected goals conceded per match: the value of the chances the opponent had. Lower is better.

entries.label: xG difference
entries.desc: xG for minus xG against per match: the underlying margin between a team and its opponents. Higher is better.

entries.label: Goals for
entries.desc: Goals scored per match.

entries.label: Goals against
entries.desc: Goals conceded per match. Lower is better.

entries.label: Finishing
entries.desc: Goals scored minus expected goals, per match: positive means the team has scored more than its chances were worth.

entries.label: Keeping
entries.desc: Expected goals against minus goals conceded, per match: positive means the team has conceded less than the chances it allowed were worth. Higher is better.

entries.label: xPts per match
entries.desc: Expected points per match: for each match, the points a team would earn on average if its xG and its opponent's xG were replayed as Poisson goal counts. Higher is better.

entries.label: Luck
entries.desc: Points minus expected points, per match: how far results have run ahead of (positive) or behind (negative) the underlying performance.

entries.label: Possession
entries.desc: Share of the ball, averaged over matches, as a percentage.

entries.label: Field tilt
entries.desc: Touches in the opponent's box as a percentage of touches in both boxes (own box touches divided by own plus opponent box touches). Above 50 means the team spends more of the game in the dangerous end than its opponents do.

entries.label: PPDA
entries.desc: Passes per defensive action: the opponent's passes divided by the team's tackles, interceptions and fouls. A low number means the team presses (it lets the opponent make few passes before engaging). Lower is better for a pressing side.

entries.label: Shots
entries.desc: Shots attempted per match.

entries.label: Shots against
entries.desc: Shots faced per match. Lower is better.

entries.label: Shot quality
entries.desc: xG per shot: the average quality of the chances a team takes. Higher means better chances, not necessarily more.

entries.label: Shot quality against
entries.desc: xG per shot faced: the average quality of the chances a team allows. Lower is better.

entries.label: Shots on target %
entries.desc: Shots on target as a percentage of shots attempted (denominator: shots).

entries.label: Big chances
entries.desc: Big chances created per match: situations where a goal is expected.

entries.label: Big chances missed
entries.desc: Big chances not scored per match. Lower is better.

entries.label: Corners
entries.desc: Corners won per match.

entries.label: Aerial duels won
entries.desc: Aerial duels won as a percentage of aerial duels contested (denominator: aerial duels contested).

entries.label: Ground duels won
entries.desc: Ground duels won as a percentage of ground duels contested (denominator: ground duels contested).

entries.label: Passes
entries.desc: Passes attempted per match.

entries.label: Pass completion
entries.desc: Successful passes as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted).

entries.label: Long-ball share
entries.desc: Long balls attempted as a percentage of passes attempted (denominator: passes attempted): a direct side runs high, a possession side low. Neither is better.

entries.label: Crosses
entries.desc: Crosses attempted per match.

entries.label: Dribbles
entries.desc: Dribbles completed per match.

entries.label: Fouls
entries.desc: Fouls committed per match. Lower is better.

entries.label: Cards
entries.desc: Card points per match: one for a yellow, two for a red. Lower is better.

entries.label: Distance (km)
entries.desc: Kilometres covered by the whole team per match.

entries.label: Sprints
entries.desc: Sprints by the whole team per match.

entries.label: Rating
entries.desc: Sofascore's average 1-10 team rating per match.

model.label: xG (expected goals)
model.desc: The chance a shot had of being scored, judged from where and how it was taken, so a tap-in is worth about 0.9 and a hopeful 30-yarder about 0.03. Added up over a match or a season it says how many goals the chances were worth.

model.label: npxG (non-penalty xG)
model.desc: Expected goals with penalties taken out (each penalty is worth 0.79). A penalty is a chance that was awarded, not created, so it flatters whoever takes them.

model.label: xGOT (expected goals on target)
model.desc: The value of a shot after seeing where in the goal it went: a shot into the top corner is worth more than the same shot straight at the keeper. Off-target shots are worth zero. Comparing xGOT with xG measures shot placement; comparing it with goals measures the goalkeeper.

model.label: xA (expected assists)
model.desc: The xG of the shot a pass set up, credited to the passer whether or not the shot went in. A creator with high xA and few assists has been let down by the finishing.

model.label: Expected points (xPts)
model.desc: The points a team would earn on average if a match were replayed with goals drawn at random from each side's xG. 3 times the probability of winning plus the probability of a draw. Over a season it is the table the chances deserved.

model.label: Luck
model.desc: Points minus expected points. Positive means results have been better than the chances justified; it usually fades, which is why a lucky team is a candidate to slide.

model.label: Strength
model.desc: The expected points per game a team would take against an average opponent at a neutral venue, from the match model. It is the site's single number for how good a team is, on the same scale for every competition.

model.label: Elo
model.desc: A rating updated after every match: the winner takes points from the loser, more when the result was a surprise. A quick, robust view of form that needs no shot data.

model.label: Attack and defence parameters
model.desc: The match model gives every team an attack number and a defence number. The goals a team is expected to score is its attack times the opponent's defence (times home advantage when at home); the model's whole prediction follows from those two numbers per team.

model.label: Home advantage
model.desc: The multiplier the model applies to the home side's expected goals, fitted from results in that competition. Typically 1.2 to 1.4, and 1 at a neutral venue.

model.label: Rho (Dixon-Coles correction)
model.desc: Treating each side's goals as independent gets low-scoring results slightly wrong: 0-0 and 1-1 happen more often than the plain numbers say, 1-0 and 0-1 less. Rho is the small correction to those four scores.

model.label: Time decay (xi)
model.desc: Older matches count for less when the model is fitted: each match's weight falls off with age at a rate set by xi. A larger xi means the model reacts faster to recent form and forgets faster.

model.label: Ridge
model.desc: A penalty that pulls every team's attack and defence numbers towards average unless the results argue otherwise. It stops a team with few matches getting an extreme rating from a couple of freak scores.

model.label: Pooled scale
model.desc: One model fitted over every league at once, with cup matches between clubs from different leagues tying the leagues together. It is what puts a Premier League club and a Brazilian club on the same strength scale; where few cup matches connect two regions the comparison leans on the ridge and is less certain.

model.label: Scoring factor (league adjustment)
model.desc: How much harder it is to score in one league than in the pool as a whole, from the pooled fit's defence numbers. A player's attacking rates are multiplied by it for the global leaderboards, so a goal in a stingy league counts for more than one in a leaky one.

model.label: Fair odds
model.desc: The decimal odds that match the model's probability exactly, with no bookmaker margin: 1 divided by the probability. A 40% chance is fair odds of 2.50.

model.label: De-vig
model.desc: Removing the bookmaker's margin from a set of odds so the implied probabilities add up to 100%. Quoted odds imply more than 100% in total; de-vigging scales them back so they can be compared with the model.

model.label: Edge
model.desc: The model's probability minus the market's de-vigged probability. A positive edge means the model thinks the outcome is more likely than the price says. It is information, not advice: the market is usually right.

model.label: Consensus
model.desc: The average of several bookmakers' de-vigged probabilities, used as the market's view of a match rather than any one book's.

model.label: Percentile
model.desc: Where a player's number sits among positional peers in the same competition, from 0 (the lowest) to 100 (the highest). A 90th-percentile figure is better than 90% of comparable players. For metrics where less is better the scale is flipped, so 100 is always best.

model.label: Minutes floor
model.desc: The minutes a player needs before their rates are compared with others: 35% of the most minutes anyone has played, between 90 and 270. Below it a per-90 number is too noisy to rank.

model.label: Shrinkage
model.desc: In the Player lab, a player's rates are blended with the positional average in proportion to minutes played, as if 450 minutes of average play were added to their record. A player with few minutes is pulled towards average; one with a full season barely moves.

model.label: Field tilt
model.desc: A team's touches in the opponent's box as a share of touches in both boxes. It says which end of the pitch the game is being played in, which possession alone does not.

model.label: PPDA
model.desc: Passes per defensive action: the opponent's passes divided by the team's tackles, interceptions and fouls. A pressing side lets the opponent make few passes before engaging, so its PPDA is low.

model.label: Monte Carlo simulation
model.desc: The rest of the season is played out thousands of times with every remaining match's result drawn at random from the model's probabilities. The share of runs in which a team finishes first is its title probability, and so on for every outcome.

model.label: Position distribution
model.desc: For each team, the share of simulated seasons that ended in each league position. The table's median finish and its 5th-95th percentile range come from it.

model.label: Bands
model.desc: The finishing positions that mean something: the title, Champions League places, other European places, the play-offs, relegation. Each team's probability of landing in each band is summed from its position distribution.

model.label: Expected result
model.desc: On a match page, the score the shots deserved: each side's xG replayed as random goals gives a probability for the home win, the draw and the away win, and the most likely score. A 1-0 with an expected result of 0.3 home win was a smash-and-grab.

model.label: Rating
model.desc: Sofascore's 1-10 match rating for each player, built from their actions in the game. Around 6.5 to 7 is an ordinary performance, 8 a very good one, 9 and above a match-winning one. Season ratings weight each match by minutes played.

model.label: Formation
model.desc: The starting shape, written defenders-midfielders-forwards (4-3-3, 3-5-2), as recorded in the lineups. The team of the week picks the shape that fits its best eleven.

model.label: Form
model.desc: Recent results, usually the last five or six matches, shown with the xG of each so a run of wins built on thin chances can be told from a deserved one.
